publisher_assessment.decision: The eight listed current consolidated Finlex law-page references are accepted as official external references. The Police Board order is accepted only as an official external locator with its listed dates, under the item-specific limitations.
publisher_assessment.basis: The Finlex site identifies its government ownership and maintenance, labels consolidated laws as current, and exposes versioned ELI identifiers. Direct page links provide a usable government-published text without requiring API registration, a local conversion pipeline, or a reconstruction of Gazette fragments.
publisher_assessment.limitation: The Finlex assessment applies to the eight statutory page references and does not establish that every relevant legal issue is covered. The Police Board listing is assessed separately: its linked PDF text and formal relationship to the historical POL-2019-71117 order remain unverified. All listed items are external references, not accepted local copies; topic coverage and country completion remain open.
